title: Holding Several Income Annuities: Ownership Provision
content:
**Provision.** An owner may hold any number of Ashgrove Income Annuities contracts, including several on the same annuitant. The number of contracts is not capped — there is no maximum number of income annuities per customer. Purchases on one annuitant are aggregated under the per-annuitant purchase limit.

| Question | Answer under this provision |
|---|---|
| Is there a limit on how many Income Annuities contracts one owner holds? | No; the count is not capped |
| May one owner hold more than one contract on the same annuitant? | Yes |
| Are purchases on the same annuitant considered together? | Yes, under the per-annuitant purchase limit |

*Hypothetical illustration.* An owner who already holds three Income Annuities contracts — two on her own life and one on her husband's — may hold a fourth; the number of contracts does not stand in the way. Whether the new purchase on her own life is accepted without home office approval is a question of the per-annuitant purchase limit, under which the purchases on her life are added together.
